sentences.text:

Court No. - 1
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13421 of 2024

Applicant :- Sachin
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mrityunjay Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar B. Saraf,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. By means of this bail application, applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.58 of 2024, under
Sections- 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B I.P.C. read with Sections - 6/10 of U.P. Public Examination
(Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998, Police Station- Trans Yamuna, District- Agra, during
pendency of trial.

entities.text:
U.P. Public Examination
(Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  It is submitted by learned counsel for applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case due to ulterior motive.

There was no any public eye witness to support the fact that the alleged incident has been committed by the applicant and although the Investigating Officer has not recorded the statement of the Principal of the college and Bio-metric Operator.

Furthermore, the co-accused namely Shiva Jeet has already enlarged on bail vide order dated 29.3.2024 passed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. bail application No.10707 of 2024, a copy of said order has been produced by learned counsel for the applicant which is taken on record.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. bail application No.10707 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
The applicant is having no criminal history to his credit and he is languishing in jail since Sachin vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145563938/
1 19.02.2024.

entities.text: Sachin vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer made in the bail application, but he could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, no criminal history related to the applicant,
nature of offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Sachin, involved in aforementioned case crime number be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the following conditions:-
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witness.

iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted and/or the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.
v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
vi.
The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
vii. In the event, the applicant changes residential address, the applicant shall inform the court concerned about new residential address in writing.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Dev/-
(Shekhar B. Saraf,J.)
